properties.name: Four root causes from the bhome and xrt-demo reports fixed at the cause: no affirmative artifact status, the guard reads the request, edges say only what they were told, and a floating root part is told the cure
properties.rationale: Each fix is at the class, not the instance. (1) is the same undefaulting already done to audience/granularity/volatility on the same type — the sweep that stopped one field short. (2) replaces one more allow-list entry with reading the request, which is not an allow-list; the pairs are still an allow-list and are extended only on evidence, as the August repair required. (3) acts on the two instances of the DROPPED req:edge-defaults-do-not-assert; the requirement itself stays dropped until Anthony says otherwise, and that is recorded as the open half. (4) fixes the words, because the code was already right and the words sent the reporter to the wrong knob.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: On Anthony's word ("let's start addressing the 4 root causes"), 2026-09-16, one PR. (1) Artifact.status carries no default; add_artifact accepts `status` and writes only what it is told; link_artifact sets `realized` on FIRST registration only (it read the checksum off disk) and never downgrades a stored status on a re-link. Nothing in the core read the field for delivery, so the default asserted and informed nothing. (2) The near-duplicate guard reads the request before refusing: a near-match the write names as its own relation target (a capability's `satisfies` or `allocated_to`, a decision's `related_to`) is never refused; and on today's count (7/0, 19/0 across three designs) Capability↔Component, Requirement↔Component, Capability↔DesignRule and Capability↔Constraint join the prescribed pairs. Component↔Component is deliberately left refusing (measured once; same-type is what the guard is for). The report is never suppressed — the match still comes back in near_matches. (3) `satisfies` accepts `coverage` (full / partial / planned), stored by a new `satisfies_with_coverage`; the delivery line counts a partial or planned satisfier as `partially_satisfied`, never as satisfaction, while an unstated coverage still reads as full so older designs do not move. CONSTRAINS.basis carries no default and `constrains` stores a basis only beside a contribution; budget_report still reads an absent basis on a stated number as `estimated`. (4) orphan_level's message names the cure — contain a top-level part under the Project with `contains` — and the adopt skill says the same where it teaches nesting; both hierarchy rules already accepted a Project parent, and the xrt-demo measurement showed the part simply was not contained. Four new test files, each written before its fix and run against the stashed, unfixed code first.
